caption: The guide's opening view: the Leonida Legend header with the 4 of 55 earned progress bar, Export and Import buttons, the spoiler-safe toggle, the amber warning about the one missable trophy, and the start of the five-stage roadmap to the platinum.

The Positive Mental Attitude guide opened in the checklist, showing the balcony meditation steps, the 18-spot count with its unconfirmed note, the numbered steps, and the cited sources below, beside the Fair Game and Don't Touch My Deck cards.

The full five-stage roadmap to the platinum, with the search box and trophy filters underneath — All 55, Story, Missable, Collectibles, Activities, Online — plus the grade filter and the count showing 55 of 55 trophies.
